create_single_scene_sampler: create a SingleSceneSampler that always returns the same scene path when sample is called
create_multi_scene_sampler: create a MultiSceneSampler that randomly samples from a list of scene paths
create_balanced_scene_sampler: create a BalancedSceneSampler that evenly distributes episodes across all provided scenes
sample_scene_from_sampler: call sample on a SceneSampler instance to get the next scene path string
set_balanced_sampler_episode: set the current episode index on a BalancedSceneSampler to control which scene is returned
